data.name: Leo
data.gender_notes: Leo is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin leo, 'lion'. Its root is Latin leo. A common Christian name; borne by several popes and saints. Leo is a Latin name meaning “Lion”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Leo expresses “Lion”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Leo total 14, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
